about: Writer B: lounge, library, desk drop-by, window and phone-booth small talk. Craft talk by discipline, friendly debates, tools and ideas, compliments and quiet company, self-aware office humour, night-floor lines, and grounded wins, projects and welcomes that play only after real events. Spec: docs/dev/OFFICE-LIFE.md §5.

lines.text: Who isn't in the room, and what would they say?

In every choice worth making.
Should a good objective make you nervous?

Says exactly why you're nervous.
Every trade thinks it is the exception.

lines.text: In my world, 'process' means people.
